data.narrative:
Western Chemicals is a pre-seed stage climate and energy company founded by Jared West (Columbia B.S. Physics and Mechanical Engineering, '20), having raised $175K to date. The valuation universe consists of nine same-sector peers—one public (LNZA) and eight private firms including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—though none provided sufficient comparability at the pre-seed stage for direct peer-median triangulation.

Given the absence of three or more same-stage climate and energy peers, the stage-progression method is the primary applicable approach. Using total raised ($175K) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for pre-seed to seed advancement yields $438K. This method alone constrains the analysis given the limited precedent available at Western Chemicals' stage and sector intersection.

The triangulated range stands at $372K to $503K, with a median of $438K. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier absent narrower peer validation and the degree to which broader climate and energy comps (which operate at later stages and larger scales) would adjust this estimate if applied. A post-seed financing round with defined investor terms would substantially increase valuation certainty.
